# The Daily Beast
> A digital news publication covering breaking news, investigations, and opinion across politics, media, entertainment, culture, and U.S. affairs.

The Daily Beast publishes fast-moving news coverage, analysis, and commentary, with dedicated sections for politics, media, entertainment, royals, innovation, newsletters, puzzles, and subscriber offerings. It also operates The Looker, a lifestyle and shopping-focused vertical.

## Main
- [Homepage](https://www.thedailybeast.com/): Front page for breaking news, politics, media, entertainment, and opinion coverage.
- [Cheat Sheet](https://www.thedailybeast.com/cheat-sheet/): Rapid roundup of major news stories and developing headlines.
- [Newsletters](https://www.thedailybeast.com/newsletters/): Newsletter hub for editorial email products and sign-up options.
- [Membership](https://www.thedailybeast.com/membership/): Subscriber plans, benefits, and paid access information.
- [Tips](https://www.thedailybeast.com/tips/): Secure tip line and contact page for sharing news leads.
- [Crossword Puzzles](https://www.thedailybeast.com/crossword-puzzles/): Crossword and games section for Daily Beast readers.

## News Coverage
- [U.S. News](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/us-news/): National news coverage, breaking developments, and major domestic stories.
- [Politics](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/politics/): Political reporting, campaign coverage, Washington news, and analysis.
- [Media](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/media/): Reporting on television, journalism, platforms, and the media industry.
- [Innovation](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/innovation/): Coverage of technology, business trends, science, and emerging ideas.
- [Obsessed](https://www.thedailybeast.com/obsessed/): Entertainment and culture coverage focused on TV, film, and streaming.
- [Royals](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/arts-and-culture/royalist/): Reporting and commentary on the British royal family and monarchy.

## Opinion & Analysis
- [Opinion](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/politics/opinion/): Opinion essays and commentary on politics, power, and current events.
- [Power 100](https://www.thedailybeast.com/keyword/power100/): Articles and features tagged to the Power 100 franchise.
- [Politics](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/politics/): News analysis and reported pieces on elections, policy, and government.
- [Media](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/media/): Criticism and analysis of press coverage, personalities, and networks.

## Entertainment & Culture
- [Obsessed](https://www.thedailybeast.com/obsessed/): Reviews, recaps, interviews, and commentary on entertainment and pop culture.
- [Royals](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/arts-and-culture/royalist/): Royal family news, palace intrigue, and monarchy-focused features.
- [Media](https://www.thedailybeast.com/category/media/): Coverage of celebrity media, television personalities, and industry narratives.
- [The Looker](https://thelooker.thedailybeast.com/): Lifestyle, beauty, wellness, and shopping-focused editorial vertical.

## Reader Products
- [Newsletters](https://www.thedailybeast.com/newsletters/): Browse and subscribe to Daily Beast editorial newsletters.
- [Crossword Puzzles](https://www.thedailybeast.com/crossword-puzzles/): Play crossword puzzles published by The Daily Beast.
- [Membership](https://www.thedailybeast.com/membership/): Join as a subscriber for premium access and membership perks.
- [Cheat Sheet](https://www.thedailybeast.com/cheat-sheet/): Quick daily digest for readers who want concise news updates.

## Community & Access
- [Tips](https://www.thedailybeast.com/tips/): Submit confidential tips and learn how to contact the newsroom.
- [Membership](https://www.thedailybeast.com/membership/): Information for becoming a paying subscriber.
- [Newsletters](https://www.thedailybeast.com/newsletters/): Sign up for recurring editorial emails and alerts.

## The Looker
- [The Looker Homepage](https://thelooker.thedailybeast.com/): Dedicated lifestyle site covering beauty, wellness, style, and shopping.
- [The Looker on The Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/the-looker): Entry point to Looker-related content on the main domain.
- [Obsessed](https://www.thedailybeast.com/obsessed/): Adjacent culture and entertainment coverage for lifestyle-oriented readers.
